comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight tail cap, set it down, tip out the battery, and return the flashlight.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually stabilizes a threaded object, performs multiple regrasped twists with axial rise, and pours out a cell.
comparison.success_condition: Cap separation and safe placement, battery collection, and flashlight return are scored; there is no captive screw, preserved setting, or dynamic calibration.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record in repeated rotary tool-free manipulation, but its tested ability is full threaded disassembly and contents extraction. The candidate keeps the screw captive, withdraws only the bit, adjusts a separate collar, and must prove stopping behavior.
